description: This Java class implements the InitializationDatabase interface and provides methods for populating initial reference data into the database for an e-commerce application, including languages, countries, zones, currencies, merchant store, modules, and product types.

classes.name: InitializationDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the InitializationDatabase interface providing database initialization routines.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates initial reference data into the database such as languages, countries, zones, currencies, modules, and merchant info.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the database has been initialized by counting existing language entries.

methods.name: createLanguages
methods.description: Creates and saves supported language entries.

methods.name: createCountries
methods.description: Creates country entries and their descriptions in supported languages.

methods.name: createZones
methods.description: Loads and creates zone entries with descriptions from a JSON configuration.

methods.name: createCurrencies
methods.description: Creates currency entries based on ISO currency codes.

methods.name: createMerchant
methods.description: Creates a default merchant store with associated tax class.

methods.name: createModules
methods.description: Loads and creates module configurations for integrations.

methods.name: createSubReferences
methods.description: Creates initial product types as sub-references.
